notes: Chess Trainer v3.0: the app is rebuilt into the chess.com app's shell — bottom nav with Home, Puzzles, Learn, Play and More tabs. New: every finished game is saved, Game Review analyses your games move by move (accuracy, Brilliant/Great/Mistake/Blunder badges, eval graph, coach explanations), and the Analysis Board lets you explore any position and play it against a bot. The Training coach now speaks in a speech bubble with a Why? button, and judges your moves with the same words as Game Review.
